output.explanation: The central tree follows runtime ownership: the Session facade holds a handle factory; SessionExecution owns its coordinator and report coordinator; LocationServiceMap caches location graphs; each graph contains the runner, whose SessionStep closure owns individual attempts and tool fibers. Shared dependencies remain peers with explicit call arrows. Two peripheral diagrams expand shared durable-state services and the other services inside each location graph, with direct connections between those diagrams. Verified against the pinned checkout, especially instance.ts, location-services.ts, session.ts, session/session.ts, execution.ts, runner/{llm,step}.ts, bus.ts, projector.ts and context.ts. Corrections: session handles do not expose every facade operation or own execution; child creation always uses the parent's location, while metadata and permissions permit overrides; SessionStep is a captured closure, not another service loop; transport, jobs, credentials and persistent PTYs are global rather than session/location-owned. An explicitly selected unavailable model errors rather than silently falling back. SessionInstructions injects durable synthetic guidance rather than owning InstructionEntry/State. Indented operation results denote temporary values, and arrows denote dependencies rather than ownership. Paths are relative to packages/core/src unless qualified.

diagrams.ascii:
OpenCode runtime - host composition (not one Session object)
|
|-- Session.Service facade [session.ts]
|   |-- create / fork / list / messages / command / log
|   |   |-- -> Project.resolve; Bus lifecycle events; Store reads
|   |   `-- create child: parent's location wins; metadata/permissions default
|   |-- Session.make() factory [session/session.ts]
|   |   `-- forSession(id): bound operations, not an owned execution engine
|   |       |-- get / rename / archive / permissions / agent / model
|   |       |   `-- -> reload Store state; publish mutations through Bus
|   |       |-- prompt / synthetic / shell / skill / compact
|   |       |   |-- -> Instance.provide: prepare input using location services
|   |       |   |-- prompt: prepare succeeds -> commit staged revert -> admit
|   |       |   `-- -> SessionInbox; wake SessionExecution unless disabled
|   |       `-- revert / resume / wait / interrupt -> maintenance or execution
|   `-- remove(id)
|       `-- -> interrupt + awaitIdle; cancel jobs; close transport; delete family
|
|-- SessionExecution [session/execution.ts; shared global service]
|   |-- SessionRunCoordinator [session/run-coordinator.ts]
|   |   `-- Execution map keyed by session ID
|   |       |-- One active fiber + completion waiter + pending wake per key
|   |       `-- drain -> Instance.provide(session) -> SessionRunner.drain
|   |-- SubagentReport coordinator
|   |   `-- -> Job settlement/outbox + parent SessionInbox delivery
|   `-- Lifecycle hooks
|       |-- Started -> Bus transaction claims durable work
|       `-- Terminal -> release claim/report commit; shutdown retains claim
|
|-- Job [job.ts]: global running/background work, recovery and report outbox
|-- SubagentJob / SessionRestart [session/subagent-job.ts; execution/restart.ts]
|   `-- -> Job.start + child resume; restart claims/jobs or deliver notices
|-- Schedule [schedule.ts]: persisted schedules + database-leased scheduler
|   `-- due work -> Session.prompt; unattended permission checks
|-- Shared durable-state services [expanded in state diagram]
|-- SessionModelTransport [session/model-transport.ts]
|   `-- Per-session connections/continuity; runner-only stateful requests
|-- Credential / LLMClient / PersistentPty: shared provider/process facilities
|-- Project: global identity resolution; workspace/worktree placement support
|
|-- Instance.Service: lends graph selected by session.location
|-- LocationServiceMap [location-services.ts]
|   `-- Cached Instance graph per canonical Location.Ref [instance.ts]
|       |-- Location + LocationLifecycle
|       |   `-- invalidation detaches routing; closes interactions, not borrowers
|       |-- SessionRunnerLLM [session/runner/llm.ts]
|       |   |-- drain / runStep: continuation, retry and max-step policy
|       |   |   |-- -> Plugin activation; Inbox promotion; Context; Compaction
|       |   |   `-- Reloaded/Moved -> execution reacquires location graph
|       |   |-- Title-generation fibers keyed by session
|       |   `-- SessionStep.make closure [session/runner/step.ts]
|       |       `-- attempt: one provider attempt, not another service loop
|       |           |-- Event publisher + scoped tool fibers
|       |           |   `-- -> Bus text/reasoning/tools/usage/error events
|       |           |-- -> LLMClient.stream; prepared.executeTool(snapshot)
|       |           `-- Join/cancel tools; capture file changes before settlement
|       `-- Shared location services [expanded in capabilities diagram]
|
`-- HTTP SessionHandler [packages/server/src/handlers/session.ts]
    `-- -> Session.Service; also transfer/instructions/forms; log replays progress

Durable-state services - global peers, shared across sessions
|
|-- Bus [bus.ts]
|   |-- Durable publish / publishAll
|   |   `-- Database transaction
|   |       |-- Sequence + event rows
|   |       |-- -> registered projectors materialize state
|   |       `-- -> local commit hook (claims/report bookkeeping); then notify
|   |-- project / replay: registered handlers, replayable durable events
|   `-- log(after, follow): history -> Synced watermark -> optional live
|       `-- subscribe is volatile; not a replay API
|-- SessionProjector [session/projector.ts]
|   |-- Registers Bus projection handlers
|   |   |-- -> SessionMessageUpdater / SessionStored / SessionBlob helpers
|   |   `-- -> lifecycle, fork, inbox, compaction, parts, cost/token rows
|   `-- Step/usage subscription -> publish aggregate session usage
|-- SessionStore [session/store.ts]
|   |-- Indexed session reads, message pages and active context
|   `-- claim / release / listSuspended -> resumable execution state
|-- SessionInbox [session/inbox.ts]
|   |-- Serialized per-session reconcile / admit / cancel / steer / queue
|   |-- -> Bus events + persisted pending user/synthetic/control rows
|   `-- nextPromotable / promote: steer between steps; queue at input boundary
|       `-- Compaction/move barriers preserve ordering
|-- InstructionEntry / SessionTransfer: shared guidance and import/export
|-- Database.Service [database/database.ts]
|   `-- SQLite tables
|       |-- event/sql.ts: sequences + durable event log
|       |-- session/sql.ts: sessions, messages, parts, inbox, instruction state
|       |-- session/sql.ts: media blobs/references; execution claim fields
|       `-- Job/schedule persistence and scheduler lease
`-- SessionHistory / SessionStats / SessionDiff / SessionRevert: helper operations
    |-- -> active transcript, usage queries, file review and history boundaries
    `-- Revert stage/clear -> Snapshot restore; commit -> Bus history mutation

Shared services inside each cached Instance graph
|
|-- SessionContext [session/context.ts]
|   |-- select -> Store + Agent + guidance + permission-filtered Tool snapshot
|   `-- load -> SessionRunnerModel + SessionHistory active transcript
|-- SessionModelRequest [session/model-request.ts]
|   |-- prepare -> system prompt + toLLMMessages + tools + model limits
|   |-- Hooks, media compatibility and output-token budgeting shape request
|   `-- Prepared request value
|       |-- Advertised definitions + retained Tool.Snapshot executor
|       |-- executeTool -> captured snapshot, not the current registry
|       `-- -> global SessionModelTransport for durable runner continuity
|-- SessionRunnerModel / ModelResolver / Model / Provider / AISDK
|   `-- Session model else agent/fallback; unavailable explicit model errors
|-- SessionCompaction / SessionTitle [session/{compaction,title}.ts]
|   `-- -> Context/model requests; summaries/precompute or title generation
|-- Agent / Skill / Reference and instruction services
|   |-- InstructionDiscovery / BuiltIns / SkillInstructions / ReferenceInstructions
|   `-- SessionInstructions -> Bus synthetic guidance; history deduplicates paths
|
|-- Tool.Service [tool.ts; tool/runtime.ts]
|   |-- Transformable registry: definitions + executors
|   |-- snapshot(policy): fixes permitted capabilities for one request
|   |   `-- CodeMode catalog -> sandbox execution over permitted tools
|   `-- execute -> before/after hooks; normalize -> ToolOutput truncation
|-- Permission / Form [permission.ts; form.ts]
|   |-- Rules + saved project approvals + pending interactive waiters
|   |-- assert -> policy/user reply; publish interaction events to Bus
|   `-- close rejects/ends waiters <- LocationLifecycle.shutdown
|-- Mcp / McpTool [mcp/; tool/mcp.ts]
|   `-- Connections/discovery -> Tool registry + context instructions
|
|-- Plugin service [plugin.ts; plugin/service.ts]
|   |-- Active generation slots and activation scopes
|   |   `-- Per-plugin host API [plugin/host.ts]
|   |-- Built-in/extension registrations -> providers, agents, tools, adapters
|   |   |-- File/shell/web/image/skill/todo/question/artifact/MCP tools
|   |   |-- Subagent tools -> Session.create/prompt + global SubagentJob
|   |   `-- Schedule tools -> global Schedule
|   `-- awaitActivation gates prompt preparation, runner steps and tool calls
|-- PluginSupervisor / module loader / Config [plugin/; config/]
|   `-- Discovery/settings/updates -> plugin generations and activation
|-- PluginHooks: prompt/context/model/tool/permission/idle extension points
|
|-- Environment: local or workspace driver selected by Location
|-- FileSystem / FileAccess / FileMutation / FileWrite / Formatter
|   `-- File tools -> environment-backed reads/search/edits and formatting
|-- Shell / Pty
|   `-- Process/terminal operations; -> global PersistentPty for daemon lifetime
|-- Snapshot / Vcs
|   `-- capture/files/diff/restore -> step change tracking and reversible edits
|
`-- Helpers executed with this graph (not separate owned services)
    |-- SessionPrompt / Command / Skill / Shell -> prepared input/completion
    |   `-- Prompt -> activation + session.prompt hook + attachment/skill materialization
    `-- SessionGenerate -> auxiliary request; no input admission/history mutation

edges.label: Expands peers within the cached location graph
Borrow location services for input preparation
Consume prepared request and captured executor
Launch child work outside plugin lifetime
